title: In Heavenly Love Abiding
lyrics_original: No change my heart shall fear;
The storm may roar about me,
My heart may low be laid,
But God is round about me,
No want shall turn me back;
He knows the way He taketh,
And I will walk with Him.
And I will walk with Him.
Which I have yet not seen;
Bright skies will soon be o’er me,
My path to life is free;
And He will walk with me.
And He will walk with me.

bible_verses.english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for being my safe refuge when the world around me feels unstable. Help me to rest deeply in Your unchanging love, knowing that You encompass my life completely. When storms rage and my heart feels weary, remind me that I am held securely in Your hands. Guide my steps today, and fill my soul with Your perfect peace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life brings unexpected storms and sudden shifts, but the love of God remains entirely steadfast. When we anchor our hearts in His abiding presence, fear loses its grip over us. No matter how fierce the winds may roar around you today, remember that the Lord surrounds you completely with His unfailing care. Step forward with quiet confidence, trusting that the One who leads you will never let you go.
